impact: Descriptive variant groups can be required or optional per item. Absent required preserves the existing mandatory behavior. Format pricing remains mandatory and descriptive choices never change its price.
releasePreparation: Local preparation only. Pin an explicitly authorized immutable Landing commit and roll out API plus compatible Web/POS consumers before exposing the Admin control. No commit, push or deployment is part of this preparation.

files.reason: Reviewed change is limited to the descriptive variant requirement: the item-specific checkbox, optional-position validation and clearing, additive required flag, or related translations and library guidance. Existing price formats, modifier limits, category/menu membership, ingredient quantities, photos, payments, fulfillment, permissions, communications and comp/void operations retain their behavior. Changed variant and order-entry procedures are documented in all three languages.
